name: Alice
source:
A cute girl [url=/c25991]Yuria[/url] encounters at a bus stop near Seirei Gakuen. She has a pretty face, does cute gestures, wears maid clothes, and has even mastered the art of doing a small bow while lightly picking the ends of her skirt with both hands.

Alice is a huge masochist who especially loves it when people bully or yell at her. Adding to this, she is a pervert who loves the smell of Yuria's crotch so much she'd want to use it as her pillow for the rest of her life. Due to the aforementioned facts everybody avoids and feels uncomfortable around Alice at school.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=728431]Getchu[/url]]
